thread:
Priya (CS): FYI - AcmeCorp reports users still have 'platform_admin' role after we processed an Okta group remove yesterday. They say the SCIM logs show 204 for the DELETE but roles didn't update in-app.
Marta (CSM): customer says this started after they enabled LDAP->Okta sync. Bulk group removes happened ~1.5h before our run.
Jordan (Eng): Can you paste the SCIM webhook delivery for one of the users? need whether we saw a PATCH or DELETE and the payload.
Priya (CS): here's one (redacted):
```
HTTP 204
Request: DELETE /api/scim/v2/Groups/{groupId}/members
Payload: { "value": "00u1a2b3c4d5" }
Headers: Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxx (scim.write scope)
```
Evan (SRE): 204 from our side means Okta accepted the call. The interesting bit is whether our mapping job that maps group->role ran successfully. The mapper service logs?
Jordan (Eng): Pulling mapper logs now — I see a handful of errors around that window: "AttributeMappingError: attribute 'memberOf' unexpected format". Looks like our SCIM parser choked on a nested array from the LDAP->Okta sync.
Logan (Identity): Okta sometimes surfaces LDAP memberOf as a single string vs array depending on connector. If our code expects array, it treats it as unknown and skips membership reconcile.
Priya (CS): So Okta sends DELETE and we accept it, but the downstream role reconciliation bails and we leave the role assigned. That fits customer report.
Marta (CSM): Customer is unhappy. They want a rollback that removes the admin role from the affected 12 users asap.
Jordan (Eng): Quick mitigation: I'll run a targeted reconciliation job for AcmeCorp that normalizes `memberOf` and forces group->role remap. Need tenant ID and list of affected users.
Priya (CS): Tenant: acme-789. Affected users (emails): alice@acme.com, bob@acme.com, carla@acme.com ... (12 total). I'll DM the full list.
Evan (SRE): Before we run it, can we add telemetry to flag other tenants with mixed-type memberOf so we don't miss repeats? I'll add a short alert rule.
Logan (Identity): Long-term fix: our SCIM parser should coerce single-value memberOf into array and make mapping tolerant. Jordan, please file a PR referencing this thread and mark as P1 for mapper.
Jordan (Eng): Will do. Quick repro I used:
```
PATCH /api/scim/v2/Users/{id}
{"members": "cn=admins,ou=groups,dc=acme,dc=com"}  <-- string instead of ["..."]
```
That triggers AttributeMappingError.
Priya (CS): Customer wants ETA. Jordan/Evan, can we get the targeted recon done within 2 hours and a permanent fix in the next sprint?
Jordan (Eng): Targeted recon: 45m. Permanent fix + tests: aim for next sprint (2w). I'll post PR link once created.
Marta (CSM): I'll update AcmeCorp and schedule a post-mortem call for tomorrow. Thanks all :raised_hands: \nOkta Bot: Delivered event for tenant acme-789 at 2025-01-17T14:12:03Z (eventId: ev_01F)
Priya (CS): Note for runbook: check `scim.parser.memberOf_type` metric and watch for non-array count > 0.
Evan (SRE): Added temporary Grafana panel and alert. I'll follow up in #eng-sre.
Jordan (Eng): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/mapper/pull/491 - includes coercion + unit tests.
Logan (Identity): I'll coordinate a small integration test with Okta LDAP connector team to validate mixed-type payloads.
Marta (CSM): Customer updated: very appreciative of fast response. Will close once recon confirmed.
Priya (CS): Marking thread resolved after recon. Closing here once I confirm removal for all 12 users.
